Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) The AI pipeline workflows (clarify / plan / implement / review_autofix YAML and their `scripts/` helpers) (RECOMMENDED)
B) The orchestrator (orchestrate / orchestrate_poll and the tracking-issue state machine)
C) Documentation only (README.md, docs/, agents.d/ fragments)
D) The AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`)
E) Other: name the exact file, workflow or command in your answer
Q2: What kind of improvement is wanted?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure (link the failing run, error message or issue number) (RECOMMENDED)
B) Reduce cost or run volume (fewer runners, API calls or model tokens)
C) Make it faster (shorter time from issue to merged PR)
D) Add a new feature or capability (describe it)
E) Readability or maintainability refactor with no behaviour change
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A) A concrete, checkable result you give in your answer, such as a failing run that now passes or a metric that drops below a stated threshold (RECOMMENDED)
B) New or updated contract tests that cover the changed behaviour pass in CI
C) A reviewer judges it by hand; no automated measure
